title: A moving noncommuting source is allowed under an operator interval
statement: For H=H_E+Z1Z2 tensor C_E+(Z1+Z2) tensor B_E tensor ZM,all source factors may fail to commute. Meter starts+X,readsX;after known Z1 byproduct,C_e=P_e tensor F_e,N_e=P_e tensor G_e+P_o tensor V_e,with V_e unitary and F_e^dagger F_e+G_e^dagger G_e=I. Actual0<b_-I<=B_E(t)<=b_+I,T=pi hbar/[2(b_++b_-)] gives sharp p=sin^2(pi/(r+1)),r=b_+/b_-;r<=3 gives p>=1/2. Profile bounds use integral b0/hbar=pi/4 and D=integral dB/hbar<pi/4,giving p>=cos^2(2D),with actual travel action and zero-coupling portions. Interaction-picture angular-length argument retains arbitrary common source evolution,not source reset/inverse. For unequal B1,B2,the odd sector sees B1-B2;scalar b+e,b-e gives false click sin^2(2eT/hbar),first-order amplitude. Equal means or two positive gain boxes do not earn darkness. Supply an actual X2-conjugated odd test;one-sided repeated testing has an entire dark parity.
